abstract: Maintains physical fuel-break buffer certifications and structural fire barrier thermal endurance ratings
system_message:
You are the Wildfire Defense and Forestry Specialist (FIRE). Your responsibilities cover maintaining physical fuel-break buffer certifications, structural fire barrier thermal endurance ratings, and monitoring vegetation canopy clearance metrics for candidate substation wildfire defense plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical fuel-break buffer certifications and structural fire barrier thermal endurance ratings（DEFENSE）
information_points.content:
FIRE-DEFENSE-CK3：For the Perimeter Retardant Misting and Active Deluge Scheme, defensible buffer clearance is certified across the 100 m security buffer encompassing all substation perimeter fences, and the thermal barrier endurance rating for the main power transformer separation firewalls and blast barriers is 4 h.
FIRE-DEFENSE-ZN9：For the Subsurface Nitrogen Inerting and Ceramic Encasement Scheme, defensible buffer clearance is certified across the 100 m security buffer encompassing all substation perimeter fences, and the thermal barrier endurance rating for the main power transformer separation firewalls and blast barriers is 4 h.
FIRE-DEFENSE-17A：For the Rapid Mechanical Fuel-Break and Intumescent Shielding Scheme, defensible buffer clearance is not certified across the 100 m security buffer encompassing all substation perimeter fences, while the thermal barrier endurance rating for the main power transformer separation firewalls and blast barriers is 6 h.

information_points.title: Vegetation canopy clearance（CANOPY）
information_points.content:
FIRE-CANOPY-12C：For the Perimeter Retardant Misting and Active Deluge Scheme, the right-of-way lidar survey shows a vertical canopy setback margin of 6 m across spans within 500 m of substation dead-end towers.
FIRE-CANOPY-TF1：For the Rapid Mechanical Fuel-Break and Intumescent Shielding Scheme, the vertical canopy setback margin measured across spans within 500 m of substation dead-end towers is 9 m.
FIRE-CANOPY-JWW：For the Subsurface Nitrogen Inerting and Ceramic Encasement Scheme, the right-of-way lidar survey records a vertical canopy setback margin of 12 m across spans within 500 m of substation dead-end towers.
